items.title: EPD vs. Exxon: Which Energy Dividend Should Retirees Trust?
items.summary: When oil cratered in 2020, two energy blue chips with decades of dividend raises faced the same brutal market, but only one kept lifting its payout through the wreckage. Knowing which one did changes everything about building a retirement income portfolio.
